1_jekyll: one man only, Dr Henry Jekyll, full figure head to feet, standing alone on a foggy gaslit London street at night. A large, well-made, tall man of fifty, of fine build, with large, firm, white and comely hands. Thick iron-grey hair, neatly brushed; smooth-faced and clean-shaven; a tall black silk top hat. Dressed in a good dark frock coat and waistcoat, a respectable professional man, calm and composed.
2_hyde: one man only, Mr Edward Hyde, full figure head to feet, standing alone on a foggy gaslit London street at night. A small, slight, dwarfish young man, pale, with lean, corded, knuckly hands of a dusky pallor, and a displeasing smile. Coarse, unkempt black hair; short, coarse black side-whiskers; a low-crowned black felt hat. In a dark coat that fits him badly, ill-kempt, hunched.
3_utterson: one man only, Mr Gabriel John Utterson the lawyer, full figure head to feet, standing alone on a foggy gaslit London street at night. A lean, long, dry, dreary man of rugged countenance that is never lighted by a smile. Lank, dust-fair hair, thin at the crown; clean-shaven; a black bowler hat. In a sober black suit with a high collar under a long greatcoat.
